prompt:
超写实夜间派对群像摄影，横版约 3:2，七名明确成年的东亚女性，20+，穿统一的紫色兔女郎舞台服装，在高层酒店酒廊 / 夜景餐厅里围成紧密一团合影。摄影者距离很近，使用约 28–35mm 等效镜头＋正面直闪，人物几乎填满整个画面，构图拥挤、有强烈真实聚会抓拍感。

七人全部穿深紫色亮片兔女郎连体衣，面料布满细小闪片，在闪光灯下出现紫蓝色高光；搭配黑色细网眼丝袜 / fishnet tights、白色立领、黑色蝴蝶结、白色腕口、紫色亮片兔耳发箍、腰后白色毛绒兔尾巴。服装统一但每个人细节略有差异，保持完整正常覆盖。

人物全部为自然纤细到轻微沙漏型身材，肩部偏窄，腰部收束，髋部圆润，大腿有真实柔软体积，不要健美肌肉或夸张比例。发型以黑色、深棕、浅棕和金棕色中长发为主，有披发、低马尾、轻卷发和碎刘海，妆容偏日系夜店派对风：明显眼线、睫毛、浅棕眼影、裸粉或豆沙色嘴唇。

构图重点是七个人前后错落挤在一起：
左侧一人侧身背对镜头后回头看镜头，腰后白色兔尾巴清楚；旁边一人正面偏侧，手持香槟杯；中后方两三人靠得很近，有人一手扶兔耳或头发；画面正中央前方一人明显俯身前倾、身体朝前、头部回看镜头，成为前景核心；右侧两人半侧身靠近桌边，其中最右人物为浅棕金发，手里拿细长香槟杯。所有人都直视或半直视镜头，神情冷淡、微笑或略带派对感，不要统一表情。

桌面与人物前方可见香槟酒杯、透明玻璃杯、酒瓶、冰桶和暖色烛光反射。背景为深棕色木质高层酒廊，落地窗外是夜晚城市灯海和高楼灯光，窗户反射室内暖光，整体背景较暗。

光线采用强烈相机直闪＋昏暗暖色环境灯：人物脸部、肩部、亮片服装和丝袜被闪光直接照亮，肤色偏暖白；紫色亮片产生大量细碎高光；背景迅速压暗，城市夜景形成零散散景。允许少量高 ISO 噪点、轻微运动模糊和边缘柔化。

整体呈 2000s–2010s 日本夜店 / 高层酒廊派对 CCD 数码相机抓拍质感：高反差、直闪、高饱和紫色、暗部偏深、轻微颗粒、有限动态范围、真实皮肤纹理，不要商业棚拍感。

重点锁定：七名成年东亚女性＋紫色亮片兔女郎服＋紫色兔耳＋白色兔尾巴＋黑色细网袜＋白色领口和腕口＋多人紧密围成一团＋中央人物前倾回头＋多人拿香槟杯＋高层夜景酒廊＋落地窗城市灯光＋正面直闪＋2000s 数码派对抓拍。

避免：少于七人、单人突出过度、白色或黑色兔女郎服、普通礼服、鞋袜颜色混乱、白天、户外、摄影棚、人物分散站成一排、过度磨皮、动漫脸、CG 感、多余人物、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en:
Hyper-realistic nighttime party group portrait photography, landscape format approximately 3:2, seven clearly adult East Asian women in their 20s, wearing uniform purple bunny girl stage outfits, huddled closely together for a group photo inside a high-rise hotel lounge / nighttime scenic restaurant. The photographer is at very close distance, using an equivalent 28–35mm lens + direct frontal flash, the subjects almost entirely filling the frame, creating a crowded composition with a strong authentic party candid snapshot feel.

All seven women wear deep purple sequined bunny girl bodysuits; the fabric is covered in tiny sequins, showing violet-blue specular highlights under the flash; paired with black fine mesh fishnet tights, white stand collars, black bowties, white cuffs, purple sequined bunny ear headbands, and white fluffy bunny tails on the back of their waists. Outfits are uniform with slight individual differences in detail, maintaining full and proper coverage.

All subjects have natural slender to subtle hourglass figures, with slightly narrow shoulders, cinched waists, rounded hips, and authentic soft thigh volume, without athletic musculature or exaggerated proportions. Hairstyles primarily feature medium-to-long hair in black, dark brown, light brown, and golden brown, styled as loose hair, low ponytails, soft waves, and wispy bangs. Makeup leans toward Japanese nightclub party style: prominent eyeliner, eyelashes, light brown eyeshadow, and nude-pink or dusty-rose lips.

Composition focuses on the seven women packed closely together with staggered depth:
On the left, one woman stands in profile with her back turned, glancing back over her shoulder at the camera, her white bunny tail clearly visible; beside her, another woman faces forward at an angle holding a champagne flute; in the middle-rear, two to three women lean close together, one resting a hand on her bunny ears or hair; directly in the front center, one woman visibly leans forward with her torso facing the camera and her head turned back to look into the lens, serving as the foreground centerpiece; on the right, two women stand in semi-profile close to the table edge, with the rightmost woman having light golden-brown hair and holding a slender champagne flute. Everyone looks directly or semi-directly into the lens, displaying cool, smiling, or slightly party-ready expressions, avoiding identical facial looks.

On the tabletop and in front of the figures, champagne flutes, clear glassware, liquor bottles, an ice bucket, and warm candlelight reflections are visible. The background is a dark brown wood high-rise lounge; outside the floor-to-ceiling windows is a sea of nighttime city lights and skyscraper illumination, with the glass reflecting indoor warm light, keeping the overall background quite dark.

Lighting utilizes a strong direct camera flash + dim warm ambient lighting: subjects' faces, shoulders, sequined outfits, and tights are directly illuminated by the flash, rendering skin tones in warm fair tones; purple sequins produce numerous fine specular glints; the background falls off quickly into deep shadows, with the city nightscape forming sparse bokeh. Allows a small amount of high-ISO noise, subtle motion blur, and soft edges.

Overall aesthetic features a 2000s–2010s Japanese nightclub / high-rise lounge party CCD digital camera snapshot texture: high contrast, direct flash, high-saturation purple, deep shadows, subtle grain, limited dynamic range, realistic skin texture, avoiding any commercial studio feel.

Key focus: seven adult East Asian women + purple sequin bunny girl outfits + purple bunny ears + white bunny tails + black fine fishnet tights + white collars and cuffs + tightly packed group cluster + central figure leaning forward looking back + multiple people holding champagne flutes + high-rise night view lounge + floor-to-ceiling windows with city lights + direct frontal flash + 2000s digital party snapshot.

Avoid: fewer than seven people, single person overly dominating, white or black bunny girl outfits, ordinary formal dresses, mismatched hosiery or footwear colors, daytime, outdoors, photo studio, subjects spread out standing in a single row, excessive skin smoothing, anime faces, CG feel, extra people, extra limbs, watermarks, and garbled text.

summaryTranslations.en: Direct-flash retro party group photo of seven East Asian women wearing purple sequin bunny girl outfits inside a high-rise lounge.
